name: Kobori Natsue
source:
A second year at Seiran High School and a member of the disciplinary commitee. Due to her incredible speed, some rumours claim she's the descendant of a ninja family, but there is no proof of this.

[from [url=http://quinrose.com/game/sw/character.html]Official site[/url]]
